MotorDebounce20.description: 20-byte debounce/integrator object. FUN_08009A40 initialises it, FUN_08009954 steps it (input 1 counts up to the limit and reloads from the reload field when reached, input 0 counts down), and FUN_08009A6E resets it.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Current count, 0 up to limit. Set to 0 by init.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Count limit, the second argument of FUN_08009A40.

fields.name: reload
fields.description: Value copied into count when the limit is reached (third argument of FUN_08009A40).

fields.name: shift
fields.description: Fourth argument of FUN_08009A40 (probably a shift or mode).

fields.name: elapsed
fields.description: Set to 1 once count reaches the limit with input 1 (probably), 0 when count returns to 0; set to 2 by init.

fields.name: latch
fields.description: Output latch cleared to 0 on the rising edge of elapsed; set to 2 by init.

fields.name: zero
fields.description: Set to 0 by init.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Set to 1 by a successful init. FUN_08009954 returns 0 while it is 0.

fields.name: pad
fields.description: Not written by the init or step code shown here (probably padding).

MotorLimiterObj.description: Limiter object initialised by FUN_08007198 (called from mcu_0160_08003784 for the object at 0x20000C3C). Fields after +0x23 are not in this packet.

fields.name: out_ptr
fields.description: Pointer to the output word (the third argument, 0x20000B3C for the object at 0x20000C3C).

fields.name: unk4
fields.description: Not written by FUN_08007198 (probably used by the later helpers).

fields.name: param2
fields.description: Second argument, stored as-is (0x03C89458 at the only call site, probably a time constant or scale).

fields.name: bound_a
fields.description: Fourth argument (probably one bound of the window).

fields.name: bound_b
fields.description: Fifth argument (probably the other bound of the window).

fields.name: half_span
fields.description: (|bound_a - bound_b| * 0x4000) >> 15, that is half the distance between the two bounds.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Sixth argument, stored as-is (probably a mode flag).

fields.name: unk25
fields.description: Not written by FUN_08007198 (probably used by the later helpers).

fields.name: zero_flag
fields.description: Set to 0 by FUN_08007198.

fields.name: one_flag
fields.description: Set to 1 by FUN_08007198 (probably 'initialised').

fields.name: flag_arg
fields.description: Seventh argument, stored as-is (probably a direction or enable flag).
